mono.usage: Data points, job numbers, VINs, invoice items

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Tactical Minimalism. 1px solid strokes or 2px inner glow highlights instead of soft shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on dark backgrounds to give an industrial matte feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only in sticky navigation and floating actionable modals. Dark background bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.neumorphism: Avoid completely. Use Grid Borders for data-heavy dashboard sections (Kanban, tables).

grids.marketing: MODE A: THE 'TETRIS' GRID. Asymmetry, Visual Tension. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8.
grids.dashboard: MODE B: HIGH DENSITY GRID. Dense, data correlation. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4.

layouts.marketing_pages: Use large typography, hero image with bg-black/40 overlay. Parallax scrolling for vehicle sections. Left-aligned content, generous spacing (p-16 to p-32).
layouts.dashboard_os: Collapsible left sidebar with top filter bar. Primary KPI hero row. High density, F-pattern scanning. Jobs Kanban uses horizontal scroll with vertical lists.
layouts.customer_portal: Cardless, rectangular, dense styles. Clean, straightforward forms for booking and quoting.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Subtle lift (-translate-y-1) for cards. Progress bars and AI estimation steps use staggered entrance animations.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-transform duration-200 ease-out. Exclude transforms from universal transitions.
motion.page_load: Framer Motion staggered children for list items in Kanban and Inventory.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast ratios. Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. Explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none on all inputs and buttons.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all heavy animations.

component_guidelines.navigation: Always visible nav. Glassmorphism dark header on marketing site. Left sidebar for the SaaS dashboard.
component_guidelines.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). High-saturation accent blocks.
component_guidelines.forms: Shadcn components heavily customized to match the tactical theme. Use Shadcn Calendar and Select.
component_guidelines.kanban: Drag-and-drop columns. Use framer-motion for drag feedback. Explicit states: Enquiry, Booked, Inspection, Quote, Authorised, In Progress, Waiting Parts, QC, Ready, Completed.
component_guidelines.toasts: Use sonner for notifications. Position bottom-right for OS, top-center for public site.

media.images: High-quality, realistic automotive and mechanic scenes. Never use placeholder URLs.
media.icons: Phosphor Icons for marketing pages. lucide-react for standard dashboard icons.
media.overlays: Images must have dark gradient overlays (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent) to ensure text readability.

3d_libraries.recommendation: React Three Fiber + Drei for the 'AI photo-based preliminary estimating' feature to show a 3D wireframe or scanning effect of a car. Use standard 2D components for the rest of the OS for performance.
3d_libraries.fallback: Framer Motion for 2D scanning animations over damage photos if 3D is too heavy.

about_workshop.description: Mechanic performing repairs. Use for About Us section.

ai_damage_estimate.description: Smashed front end. Use as the demo image for the AI preliminary estimating feature.

gallery_2.description: Silver car parked indoors. Use in services/gallery.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the tactical minimalism style. Avoid excessive drop shadows; use 1px borders to separate components in the OS.
Always use the provided image URLs. Do not use generic placeholders like via.placeholder.com.
In the SaaS Dashboard, implement a collapsible left sidebar with top-left north star metrics.
For the Kanban board, ensure smooth drag-and-drop interactions using framer-motion.
The AI photo estimator section should have a technical/scanning UI overlay (using ASCII art or grid overlays) to emphasize 'AI'.
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).
Use Shadcn components for forms, tables, and dialogs, but strip out the default Vercel aesthetic in favor of the dark, industrial brand theme.
Implement both the public marketing site and the internal OS routes cleanly.
Ensure the hero image has a dark overlay (`bg-black/50`) so text is readable.
universal_guidelines: DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical grids for marketing and high-density grids for dashboards.
Use glass-morphism effects (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl) for floating elements like sticky navs and dialogs.
Never apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-transform transition-opacity`.
DO NOT center align the app container. Respect natural reading flow.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) for icons. Use proper icon libraries.
Do not use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background
